label: baseline-v0
name: Baseline v0
change: original pipeline: dense search only (multilingual-e5-small, pgvector HNSW)

label: baseline-v0-cache
name: Embedder cache
change: + embedding model loaded once instead of per question (retrieval only, not judged; still approximate HNSW search)

label: baseline-v1
name: Baseline v1
change: + exact vector search per index (the shared HNSW index made recall depend on what else was in the database); answers generated from the top 5 and judged on full chunks (official baseline)

label: hybrid-v1
name: Hybrid search
change: + BM25 keyword search in PostgreSQL, fused with dense results (RRF)

label: lexical-v1
name: BM25 only
change: BM25 keyword search alone, no embedding (comparison point for 9.2, not kept)

label: rerank-v1
name: Re-ranking
change: + cross-encoder bge-reranker-v2-m3 on the fused candidates

label: rerank-dense-v1
name: Dense + re-ranking
change: cross-encoder on dense candidates only, no BM25 (comparison point for 9.3, retrieval only)

label: citations-v1
name: Citation resolver
change: dense search + legal citations: "art. N da Lei X" is parsed, search is restricted to that law and the cited article is pinned first (comparison point, no BM25 or re-ranking)

label: full-v1
name: Full pipeline
change: hybrid search + re-ranking + citation resolver (current default)

label: rerank-sorted-c40
name: Sorted re-ranking batches
change: + re-ranking pairs sorted by length before batching: same scores, less padding (retrieval only, not judged)

label: rerank-sorted-c20
name: Fast re-ranking
change: 20 re-ranking candidates instead of 40 (latency option, retrieval only)

label: rerank-sorted-c30
name: 30 candidates
change: 30 re-ranking candidates (latency sweep point, retrieval only)

label: answer-lang-v1
name: Multilingual fallback prompt
change: answer prompt with a fallback sentence in three languages and "answer partially" (rejected: refusals doubled)

label: prompt-v4
name: Grounded prompt
change: + answer prompt in the question's language, quote the answering sentence before answering (fewer unjustified refusals, no wrong-language answers)

label: gen-qwen36-v1
name: Qwen3.6 answer writer
change: same pipeline and prompt, answers written by Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE) on llama.cpp instead of qwen2.5:7b
